meta.evidence_status: simulation (pencil model P1, synthetic handwriting and tremor; nothing measured)

protocol.reference: same pencil, NEUTRAL, same handwriting without tremor (harness convention)
protocol.ratio: e_rms(controller, tremor) / e_rms(neutral, tremor), both against the reference
protocol.distortion: controller on the tremor-free handwriting against the reference
protocol.oracle: disturbance = housing position minus its clean (neutral, no tremor) path
protocol.q_sat_frac: fraction of evaluated contact time with the command at >= 95 % of the 0.30 mm soft limit, the drive voltage saturated, or the stage on its stop
protocol.P_rail: mean rail power over the run (both axes): class-B/switch-to-rail and charge-recovery conventions (sim/pencil/power.py)
protocol.integration: symplectic Euler, dt 25 us (highest modes: nib-paper contact 1.2 kHz, stage 192 Hz; omega*dt <= 0.19); servo 10 kHz, estimator 2 kHz

servo_check.feedforward: k_tot q_ref + m_eq q_ref'' + static normal-load bias (contact-gated, constant, not measured-force)
servo_check.label: CALCULATION (discrete loop: ZOH, 0.1 ms Hall delay, 2 kHz driver pole)

m1_crosscheck.note: same handwriting and tremor; M1 'rigid' mode vs the pencil model with stage and axial slide locked, skid off, M1's housing mass and paper contact: the physics coincide, so the traces must agree

battery.note: rail powers from the simulation (1 um Hall noise at 10 kSPS included); DRV2700 quiescent 72 mW, recovery stage 1 mW
